title: The Quarry's Hide
text: The quarry hides in a thicket of black thorn so dense that no light gets in. It thinks no one can see it there. You can hear it breathing, slow and wet, and smell its musk on the wind.

options.label: Rush into the black thorn and catch it before it knows you are there.

outcomes.text: The thorns tear at everything on the way in. It is waiting in the middle.

options.label: Burn it out of the thicket and meet it as it runs.

outcomes.text: It bolts out of the smoke and straight into your blades.

options.label: The patient one waits for it to come out, however long that takes.

outcomes.text: At last it leaves, and you have the drop on it.
